sections.name: File setup, PersonaSlug, PERSONA_SLUGS
sections.title: Loading the five analysts
sections.what: Imports the card file for each analyst and lists the five public slugs. Every analyst is an AI analyst with a public name.
sections.why: Keeps each analyst's details in its own file, so edits do not need code changes.
sections.watch_out: A new analyst must be added to both this import list and the slug list, or it will not appear.

sections.name: cardSchema
sections.title: Rules every analyst card must meet
sections.what: Describes the fields each card must have: slug, display name, sport, sport key, skill area, colour name, signature tool and at least three skill words. Unknown fields are refused.
sections.why: Catches a mistyped or incomplete card before the page shows it.
sections.watch_out: The allowed names and colours are typed here separately from the landing copy and must be kept in step by hand.

sections.name: PersonaCard, isPersonaSlug
sections.title: Building the analyst lookup
sections.what: Checks each imported card against the rules and builds a lookup from slug to card. Also provides a check for whether a text value is a valid analyst slug.
sections.why: Makes looking up an analyst safe.
sections.watch_out: A failed check throws when the module loads, which stops every page that imports it.

summary: Loads the five public AI analysts from their card files and checks each card against strict rules.
purpose: It provides the analyst list and details used across the app, such as their names, colours and signature tools.
why: Likely reason: keeping each analyst in its own card file makes edits easy, and checking them on load catches mistakes early.
how: It imports each card file and lists the five slugs. It defines a strict rule for the card fields, checks every card against it when the module loads, and builds a lookup by slug. A helper confirms whether a text value is a valid slug.
inputs: The five card files in their folders.
outputs: A lookup of analyst cards by slug, the list of slugs, and a check for valid slugs.
risks: A card that breaks the rules throws an error on load, which stops any page that imports this file.
debug: Read the error from the card check: it names the field that failed. Check that the card file has only the allowed fields.
